Class TerminalPaste

java.lang.Object
org.aetheris.swing.TerminalPaste
final class TerminalPaste extends Object
The TerminalPaste class decides what text the terminal will send. The notebook asks for that decision. The client then writes a bracketed paste. This class does not open a window. This class does not append Enter.

  • Method Details

    • decide

      static TerminalPaste.Decision decide(boolean ephemeral, String assistant, String user)
      The method chooses the text a bracketed paste would send. An ephemeral cell returns TerminalPaste.Kind.EPHEMERAL and an empty body. A null reply is treated as empty. A reply whose trimmed length is zero falls through to the prompt. A null prompt is treated as empty. A chosen string whose length is zero returns TerminalPaste.Kind.EMPTY. The chosen string is passed through ConsolePaste.normalize(String), which turns CR LF and a bare CR into LF. This method does not append Enter. A normalized body longer than ConsolePaste.MAX_CHARS returns TerminalPaste.Kind.OVER_CAP and an empty body. Any shorter body returns TerminalPaste.Kind.READY.
      Parameters:
      ephemeral - The flag is true when the cell is ephemeral.
      assistant - The assistant value is the reply text, and it may be null.
      user - The user value is the prompt text, and it may be null.
      Returns:
      The return value is the decision for that cell.
